summary: Fixed Template upgrade to refresh stale Fallow recorded-hits analysis identity when Fallow or TypeScript settings change without silently absorbing new findings, guard retried upgrades from re-recording hits via a per-worktree git mark, classify existing-code failures against newly added or changed gates under a separate gate-adoption-required outcome (exit 6), and print worktree unlock and remove steps whenever an upgrade stops with a locked worktree.
